reviews.review:
A slap in the face for all Garfield Kart fans. 

Garfield Kart furious racing is a very competent kart racer with a uniquely Garfield-type feel and I had big expectations for this entry in the series. Unfortunately this game blows. Settling in for a session of "Garfield Kart - Furious Racing" feels like a Saturday or perchance a Sunday, but "Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift" feels more like a Monday.

The game itself feels bad and the controls are slippery. If you wanted to change said controls that sucks because you can't. If you want to change the volume of the game you should consider unplugging your headphones because there are no audio settings either. I have also experienced a bug on multiple occasions in my limited time playing the game where you simply pass through all item boxes and coins. 

There are only 3 cups and while they do at least have a good variety of themes between the three of them, the maps within each one are too similar to stand out from one another. The maps themselves are boring and often times incredibly short. To deal with this the developers have simply made it so you have to do an absurd number of laps around these uninspired circles they call a "wacky circuit". 

The graphics are an interesting change for the series but slapping a comic book filter over the whole game does not make up for the lack of any good content. I have not tried online and I don't intend to. I have seen enough. I will be returning this plate of lasagna back to the kitchen.
